fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Marking Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a glob at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Longer Look
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 20% further.

fusions.name: Patient Stalk
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
